name: RATING-MARGIN singles (spread + ML, shadow)
rule: Fit ridge offence/defence ratings on all official FINAL games to date; p_home = Phi(margin_hat / (sigma * k)); k chosen on the last 40 training games. One unit per game on the side with p >= 0.5. No totals, no props, no parlays.
edge_claim: opponent-aware margin model beats a coin on proper scores
mindchange_for: Brier skill vs coin > 0 with a game-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 on a prospective sample of >= 100 games
mindchange_against: lower bound <= 0 after 100 prospective games, or calibration slope outside [0.8, 1.25] on the same sample
registration_basis: this file's first commit on branch arena/ca1b3769-own6

name: TOTAL-MARGIN singles (fair total, shadow)
rule: Publish the model's fair total (exp_away + exp_home) for every fixture and compare it with the official card only. No bet is placed while no price exists.
edge_claim: expected points carry information about the realised total
mindchange_for: CORR-03 out-of-sample correlation > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0
mindchange_against: CORR-03 out-of-sample CI includes 0 after 100 prospective games
registration_basis: this file's first commit on branch arena/ca1b3769-own6

name: GAME PARLAY: favourite ML + over (joint-copula)
rule: Only rankable when a directly validated JOINT probability exists; multiplying marginals is forbidden by G-JOINT.
mindchange_for: n_validated_joint >= 1 and void/push rules on file
mindchange_against: any leg of the joint uses a marginal product as its probability

name: SAME-GAME PARLAY: QB pass yards over + WR rec yards over
rule: Requires player-level official stats for every leg; blocked until G-PLAYERSTATS clears.
mindchange_for: >= 100 player-games of official stat lines captured
mindchange_against: legs remain dependent through the same passing volume

name: PROP COMBO: two rushers over on the same team
rule: Same-team carries are negatively correlated; a combo may only be ranked with a measured joint distribution, which needs snap/target shares (G-SNAP).
mindchange_for: official snap counts for >= 8 games of the same backfield
mindchange_against: no snap-count source verified for the 32 clubs
